findings.title: Advertised price agrees across retrieved versions

findings.title: No-fee does not mean no additional costs

findings.title: Availability needs a current confirmation
findings.detail: The retrieved listing advertises immediate move-in. TinyFish could not refresh the candidate pages because access was blocked; Exa did not supply its acquisition date. No manager has confirmed availability.

findings.title: Building amenities are advertised
findings.detail: The listing describes doorman service, fitness facilities, building laundry and a roof deck. Operating hours, access charges and actual condition were not independently checked.

findings.title: Official building records not assessed
